top_events.title: COP31 fails to reach major climate deal as talks expose deep divisions
top_events.label: COP31 climate summit ends without deal
top_events.summary: The UN climate summit in Turkey ended without agreement after countries failed to reach consensus on tackling climate change, marking the first such failure since 2009.

top_events.title: California's coastal communities on alert as biggest waves in years hit state
top_events.label: California hit by record coastal waves
top_events.summary: Multiple coastal hazard warnings were issued across California as powerful swells and waves of more than 9 metres were recorded throughout the week.

top_events.title: Russian vessel hit by suspected Ukrainian drone at Libya's Benghazi port
top_events.label: Ukrainian drone strikes Russian ship Libya
top_events.summary: A suspected Ukrainian drone attack caused an explosion on a Russian warship docked at Libya's Benghazi naval base. The vessel had stopped for fuel and supplies on its way back to Russia.

most_significant_event.summary: Workers and students protest across Europe over wages and high living costs, inspired by French demonstrations. Reflects ongoing cost-of-living pressure affecting Portugal.
